يستكثروا (form X)
# يَسْتَكْثِرُوا (yastakṯirū) /jas.tak.θi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# يُسْتَكْثَرُوا (yustakṯarū) /jus.tak.θa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
